review-only.task: Review the uncommitted change for correctness; do not edit or post anything.

findings.title: Preserve quantity in cart totals
findings.explanation: The uncommitted change removes quantity multiplication. Every item with quantity greater than one is undercounted. The existing single-quantity test passes and does not cover this regression.

from settings import timeout_seconds; print('None:',timeout_seconds(None)); print('0:',timeout_seconds(0)); print('5:',timeout_seconds(5)); print('empty string:',timeout_seconds(''))

diagnosis-only.task: timeout_seconds(0) returns 30, but zero should be preserved; diagnose only, do not change files.
diagnosis-only.diagnosis: settings.py:2 uses value or 30. Python treats zero as false, so the fallback is selected for zero as well as None. Nonzero input 5 survives, which distinguishes a falsiness fallback from a function that always returns 30.
diagnosis-only.proposed_correction: If None is the only missing-value sentinel, return 30 if value is None else value. This is a proposal only; no correction was applied.
diagnosis-only.remaining_uncertainty: The task establishes that zero must be preserved but does not establish validation policy for empty strings or other nonnumeric inputs.

implement-agreed.verification_guidance: kp-debug for causal check and kp-verify-change for behavioral evidence were read; no interview, planning phase, or additional agent was used.

limitations: One reviewer and one run; no repeated trials or no-skill baseline.
Router instructions and task-specific skills were explicitly supplied; this does not test automatic host discovery.
The 24 routing responses are judgments made from the router, not 24 executed end-to-end task runs.
The three executed Python fixtures are deliberately small; no UI, remote service, publishing, production, or long-running task was exercised.
File hashes cover all regular fixture files outside .git. Git HEAD, status, and review diff were also captured; this is not a byte-for-byte audit of Git metadata.
The proposed checks in the pstack source review remain unrun; these fixtures exercise the new personal pack only.
No claim of measured uplift, causal effectiveness, or general quality follows from these observations.
